Messages.Author: Lech
Messages.Body:
Ekkehard
Group 1

Sabbat. Black Hand: Ekkehard may remove 3 master cards or 3 cards with the same name from any Methuselah's ash heap to make that Methuselah burn 2 pool as a  action.

His special is good against master-heavy decks, and decks that spam certain cards (animalism combat comes to mind).

Keeping in mind that expansion will be mostly vampires it's wise to suggest vampires mostly.

Sabbat.Black Hand Shakar: Lech loathe ranged weapons. Once each action, he may burn 1 blood to become Camarilla Prince of Krakow until the end of the action.

Also, this action can be blocked, you remove the cards after the action is successful and it's not much stronger from bleed for 2. In theory it can be combined with freak drive and trochomancy to deal 5 pool damage and remove 10 cards from ash heap, but in practice with just    he can be blocked. As a finishing touch unblockable pool damage thanks to daring the dawn seems strong, but vignes do it better.

Decks that use many copies of one cards aren't hurt by his special much. It start to shine against decks packing recursion, and it would be fun if Ashur's Tablets would be hosed by progeny of Ashur (Cappadocians, here named Harbringers of Skulls).
